Title: NETMESSAGE:Good morning soldiers.\n You`re chosen to take care of a special task\n concerning the black mesa facility.
Translation: 早上好，士兵们。\n 你被选中去执行一项特殊任务\n 关于黑山基地。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Your mission is to Infiltrate the complex\n to find Gordon Freeman\n and to kill him.
Translation: 你的任务是潜入设施\n 找到戈登·弗里曼\n 并杀了他。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Commander, We`ve located the position of the target.\n It`s in Sector 4e.
Translation: 指挥官，我们已定位目标位置。\n 它在4e区。

Title: NETMESSAGE:OK. You know what to do.\n The teleporter will take u to Sector 4e.\n ...Good luck...
Translation: 好的。你知道该怎么做。\n 传送器会带你们去4e区。\n ...祝你好运...
